[SWS_SomeIpXf_00235] Upstream requirements: SRS_Xfrm_00101, SRS_Xfrm_00008 ⌈If the value of dynamicArraySizeProfile equals VSA_LINEAR, the value of the length field of the serialized variable size array shall be calculated based on the value of the size indicator of the AUTOSAR data type. ⌋ The number of static length elements can be easily calculated by dividing the array length n by the Byte size of an element. In the case of dynamical length elements the number of elements cannot be calculated but the elements must be parsed sequentially .
